get_random_sentence: extract a random sentence from a given text string using regex-based sentence splitting
get_topk_words: return the top k most frequent words from a text with their occurrence counts
test_get_random_sentence: test get_random_sentence by passing a multi-sentence paragraph and verifying a valid sentence is returned
test_get_topk_words: test get_topk_words by passing sample text and k=3 to verify top 3 words are returned
refactor_get_topk_words: refactor get_topk_words to use collections.Counter for more efficient word frequency counting
